context: Upstream has no patched braces release. Trusted local source/build glob processing only; no public pattern-processing endpoint or production Node server. Only dist/client is supported for hosting.
controls: Never build unreviewed source on a privileged machine
revisit: Upgrade when a compatible upstream patch exists. Do not downgrade vinext to an obsolete release or use npm audit fix --force. Any new advisory, changed package version or expiry fails the policy.
